description_en: Updates the information about a virtual resource group
kebab_example: aliyun eas update-virtual-resource --cluster-id cn-hangzhou --virtual-resource-id eas-vr-npovr28onap1xxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVirtualResource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the virtual resource group belongs
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟资源组所在的地域
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual resource group
parameters.name: virtual_resource_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to disable the retention period of preemptible instances
parameters.help_zh: 是否关闭竞价型实例保留时长
parameters.name: disable_spot_protection_period

fields.help_en:
The instance type of the public resource group.

You must specify one and only one of the InstanceType, ResourceId, and QuotaId parameters
fields.help_zh:
公共资源组机型规格。
<notice>用户必须指定InstanceType、ResourceId和QuotaId中的一个字段，且只能指定一个。></notice>
fields.name: instance_type

fields.help_en: The priority of resource scheduling. A greater number indicates a higher priority
fields.help_zh: 资源调度优先级。数字越大，调度优先级越高
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The ID of the Lingjun resource quota.

You must specify one and only one of the InstanceType, ResourceId, and QuotaId parameters
fields.help_zh:
灵骏资源配额ID。
<notice>用户必须指定InstanceType、ResourceId和QuotaId中的一个字段，且只能指定一个。></notice>
fields.name: quota_id

fields.help_en: The region in which the resource resides
fields.name: region

fields.help_en:
The ID of the dedicated resource group. For information about how to obtain the ID of a dedicated resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html.

You must specify one and only one of the InstanceType, ResourceId, and QuotaId parameters
fields.help_zh:
专属资源组ID。如何查询专属资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html。
<notice>用户必须指定InstanceType、ResourceId和QuotaId中的一个字段，且只能指定一个。></notice>
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The maximum price of preemptible instances in a public resource group.

If you leave this parameter empty, preemptible instances are not used
fields.help_zh:
公共资源组抢占实例价格上限。
<notice>不设置代表不使用抢占式实例。></notice>
fields.name: spot_price_limit

parameters.help_en:
The resources in the virtual resource group.

If you specify this parameter, previous data is overwritten
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟资源组包含的资源列表。
<notice>如果指定，将会覆盖先前的数据。></notice>
parameters.name: resources

parameters.help_en: The new name of the virtual resource group
parameters.name: virtual_resource_name
